Chiropractor, Dr. Rick Belling, is the founder of Back Bay Wellness in Newport Beach, CA. He works alongside Dr. Alex Vanderschelden, known as the 'OC Chiropractor' whom together have amassed millions of followers.

Dr. Belling specializes in many Chiropractic techniques and Sports Rehabilitation procedures including Diversified, Gonstead, Sports Medicine, Spinal Corrective Therapy, Myofascial Release Techniques, Wellness Care, as well as Spinal Decompression.

Reach out today to schedule an appointment with the crack master, Dr. Belling! 
(949)-631-0200

Back Bay Wellness 
1601 Dove St. Ste. 190 
Newport Beach, CA 92660 

​
